description: The pie chart presents the distribution of videos across content categories, showing 13 slices in total. The slices are labeled with percentages inside the wedges and include: People Blogs (orange, ~17.2%), a purple slice (~13.9%, label not clearly visible), Howto Style (green, ~9.7%), Education (red, ~8.7%), Sports (pink, ~7.7%), Gaming (gray, ~6.4%), Science Technology (blue, ~6.4%), Comedy (cyan, ~5.6%), Travel Events (yellow-green, ~4.6%), Film Animation (brown, ~4.6%), News Politics (light orange, ~4.3%), Pets Animals (green, ~3.9%), Autos Vehicles (red, ~4.8%), and Music (light purple, ~2.3%). There is no separate legend visible, no slices appear exploded or offset, and the slice order appears to follow the circular placement rather than a clearly descending or ascending size arrangement.
